title: Schnozzberry Drink Delivery
description: Schnozzberry Drink Delivery — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Chet the Decembrist

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Go to The Whisker's Library - Propaganda Section (off Level 1 of Ratsputin's Gulag). Find Chet the Decembrist and give him this Schnozzberry drink.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Chet the Decembrist

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Kvasier Drink Order

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Go to The Whisker's Library - Propaganda Section (off Level 1 of Ratsputin's Gulag). Find Chet the Decembrist and give him this Schnozzberry drink.

Offer:

'Khodebshchik! Bringing the Schnozz and One-Eye berry together for yummy goodness!' It's the first draft of my slogan. Do you like it? I'll work on my delivery while you work on this delivery.

There is a protester that's been standing around for ages. He's dying to get his hands on some tasty beverages. 'Khodebshchik's beverages, I deliver wet mouth explosions on time!' Heh, you like that one? It kinda slaps you upside your face and shakes you silly right?

Take this Schnozzberry drink to the lonely, tired, and parched protester in The Whisker's Library - The Propaganda Section. It is located off of the first level of Ratsputin's Gulag. Khodebshchik's, the 'drinkmaster mixer,' in Ratsputin's Holding Cell will have more work for you when you have this quest for quintessential quaffing quota completed.

Turn-in:

Hey, that looks pretty good!

GULP!

UGH! Did you spit in this? What, are you trying to kill me!? Uh oh! I'm feelin' kinda queasy.

It tastes like I just ate a nice greasy pork sandwich served in a dirty ash-filled urn.

Who gave this to you? Do I have a price on my head for protesting?

Well, it won't stop me...and to show you I'm a good sport, I'll even pay you half for drinking this freak juice!

Objectives:

  • Schnozzberry Drink ×1

Level range: 75–100
